title: A Float-style capacity planner, built by Claude from one spec #shorts
description:
Free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/capacity-planner?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=capacity-planner

Claude built a capacity planner, a Float alternative that works out each person's real capacity every week from their working hours, holidays and time off and flags over-booked weeks before anyone says yes, from one written spec: all 33 acceptance checks passed, along with 222 automated tests. The test build also exposed 89 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed; production sign-in, real email delivery and hosting were not tested.

Float's Starter plan is $7 per scheduled person per month billed yearly ($840 a year for 10 people); Pro is $12, per float.com/pricing (checked November 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera intro and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
